description: Draw a map of US counties coloured by a number: all of the US, or the counties of one state. Name counties with their state ("Cook, IL", "Los Angeles County, California") or use 5-digit FIPS codes ("17031"). With 'state' set, bare county names are looked up in that state. For states, use generate_country_map with country 'US'. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel links.

brandTheme.description: Name of a brand theme saved on the user's account (their colours and footer), only when the user asks for their theme. Or "colorblind" for colours that people with colour-vision deficiency can tell apart (anyone can use it).

format.description: png (default) or svg. SVG returns a link to a vector version of the map.

labels.description: Write each area's name, value or both on the map (default none). Labels that don't fit are left out.

state.description: Only this state, e.g. 'TX' or 'Texas'. Leave out for the whole US.

name: generate_county_map
title: US county map
